errors.csv_invalid: The file has errors: nothing was imported.
errors.csv_encoding_invalid: The file is not UTF-8. Save it as « CSV UTF-8 » from your spreadsheet.
errors.csv_header_invalid: The file columns do not match the template (column concerned: {column}).
errors.csv_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows (maximum {max}).
errors.csv_too_many_columns: The row has more columns than the header: put texts that contain the separator between quotes.
errors.csv_field_unterminated: A quoted text starts on line {line} and is never closed.
errors.csv_content_type_unsupported: The file must be sent as CSV (text/csv).
errors.csv_theme_not_found: Theme not found among the ones you can use.
errors.csv_theme_ambiguous: Several themes have this name: make it more precise.
errors.csv_correct_invalid: The « correct » column must list filled-in answer numbers, from 1 to 4, separated by « | ».
errors.csv_audio_unsupported: The import does not handle audio: add the excerpt from the question page.
errors.csv_media_url_required: An image or a video needs an address in « media_url ».
errors.csv_media_url_invalid: The media address must start with http:// or https://.
errors.csv_question_duplicate: This question already exists in the theme, or earlier in the file.
errors.question_company_required: Choose the company to import into.
errors.question_kind_invalid: Unknown question type (qcm, true_false or estimate).
errors.question_type_media_invalid: Unknown media type (none, image or video).
errors.question_kind_media_invalid: A true / false or estimate question only accepts text or an image.
errors.question_answers_min_required: A question needs at least two answers.
errors.question_correct_answer_required: At least one correct answer is required.
errors.question_true_false_answers_invalid: A true / false question has two answers, « Vrai » and « Faux », with one correct.
errors.question_estimate_answers_invalid: An estimate has 3 or 4 ranges starting with a number, with one correct.
